method: Direct inspection of native 960x540 framebuffer captures against official DreadOut screenshot references and previous same-position game captures; subjective art-direction review, not a quantitative parity/FPS score.
findings: Night street retains visible asphalt detail with local warm pools; strong uniform blue reflections removed
Porch, window and shop practicals read as local sources
Atmaja exterior stays dark and derelict; phone-lit plaster, wood and furniture remain visible
First-person handset feed and third-person avatar present in the relevant posed shots
limitations: Whole-game visual parity with DreadOut is not established
No manual Windows or Iris Xe performance acceptance
